entries.text: Choose useful capabilities in other harnesses against a concrete receiving need. Preserve their provenance, and compare existing support before porting anything.
entries.title: Observe before adapting

presentation.author: Nicolás Echániz & CompAII
presentation.boundary: This is one Wiggle bag, stewarded by AlterMundi/Skills. It does not own the general Wiggle Stash or an automatic observer.
presentation.next: Choose one useful capability and one receiving need, then compare the existing support before deciding what to adapt.
presentation.occasion: When a useful capability appears in another harness, or a concrete need exposes a gap.
presentation.origin: Retained as an initial bag in the Wiggle Stash discussion on 12 October 2026.
presentation.possibility: Observe useful skills, preserve their provenance, select a small improvement and adapt it for a receiving harness. Share portable principles through AlterMundi/Skills and contribute general improvements upstream when they fit.
presentation.subtitle: Let useful discoveries travel between our tools.
presentation.why: Different harnesses develop useful ways of working. Inspecting those capabilities and choosing adaptations for real needs can help the tribe learn without losing each tool's strengths.
